notes: This contract pins the bounded embedded IEEE 1516.1-2025 C++ restore control path to the official Requirements Lab surfaces. It covers request success/failure, federation-begun and initiate callbacks, complete/not-complete/abort, status response, and in-memory snapshot rollback. Focused cases restore a pre-save live interaction payload and retraction ledger after a post-save Retract terminalized that record, retain a saved terminal tombstone's MessageCanNoLongerBeRetracted classification, return saved logical-time and actual-lookahead state after post-save mutations, and retain one deferred lookahead-decrease target through restore. Timed restore, distributed transport, durable external persistence, handle remapping, service-wide interlocks, protected review, package support, and conformance remain open.
